thread:
lena: Heads-up: planning TLS hardening next weekend. Need sign-off on RBAC changes for KMS unwrap and audit fields before we touch prod.

omar: Can you summarize the RBAC delta? I want to check smallest possible scope for service accounts.

lena: Delta: add `kms:Decrypt` equivalent to `keystore.unwrap` but scoped to `projects/redwood/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*/cryptoKeyVersions/*` for the cert rotator principal only. Also add a read-only binding for observability to read unwrap audit events (no decrypt).

omar: So two bindings: rotator-unwrap (narrow) + obs-read (audit-only). Makes sense. Any per-region exceptions?

lena: Yes. Default central KMS; add allowlist for ap-south and cn-region tenants that require local keys. Exceptions will be explicit resources, not wildcards.

dakota: Audit logging proposal: include `event_type: "unwrap_attempt"|"unwrap_success"|"unwrap_fail"`, `actor`, `key_id`, `region`, `peer_sni`, `cert_fingerprint`, `tls_version`, `cipher_suite`, and `ocsp_status`. Ship to `security.tls` and forward to longterm WORM for 180 days.

kms-ops-bot: scheduled maintenance window requested for 2026-04-05T01:00Z-2026-04-05T04:00Z pending approvals.

lena: Important: do NOT include private cert material in logs. Use `cert_fingerprint` only. Mask principal IDs if needed. Log schema must pass privacy review.

omar: For rollout, propose phased canary by traffic percentage using platform feature-flagging: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Each stage 20m observation. If unwrap_error_rate or tls_handshake_5xx > 0.3% for two consecutive windows, abort.

dakota: I want an explicit fallback: if unwrap fails, route to `in-region-cache` keystore (read-only) and emit metric `tls.unwrap.fallback=true`. Client responses should include `x-tls-status: degraded` for visibility.

lena: Agreed. Create a runbook stub: steps to revert RBAC (remove rotator binding), promote fallback keystore, and rollback feature flag. Also a communications blurb for status page.

omar: Can we add an automated smoke test to preflight? Sample command below:

```
# verify TLS profile and OCSP
curl -sI --max-time 10 https://svc-canary.eu-west.example | grep -i "OCSP" || echo "stapling-missing"
openssl s_client -connect svc-canary.eu-west.example:443 -servername svc-canary.eu-west.example -tls1_3 < /dev/null 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,60p'
```

lena: Nice. Also include a quick probe for KMS unwrap: `kms-ops-cli simulate-unwrap --key=projects/... --token=rotator-token` (in preprod only).

dakota: Monitoring: dashboards for `unwrap_latency_p50/p95`, `unwrap_error_rate`, `handshake_success_rate`, `stapling_missing_count`. Alert if unwrap_p95 > 500ms or unwrap_error_rate > 0.3% over 10m.

omar: Who's doing the IAM change? @lena? We'll need two reviewers: security and infra. Also audit-annotate approvals in IAM change log.

lena: I'll open the IAM PR and include the allowlist JSON and reviewer checklist. ETA Thu EOD.

dakota: I'll produce the log schema and sample event by Wed. Keep field names snake_case.

omar: We should validate client compatibility: create a list of services pinned to TLS1.2 and schedule migration (payment-proxy, analytics-ingest, partner-batch). Can we throttle them behind a TLS upgrade gateway?

lena: Yes — plan: route legacy clients through an upgrade gateway that supports TLS1.2 -> mTLS termination internally. Gateway will be in ap-south only for now. Track metric `legacy_gateway_requests`.

dakota: Security note: enforce cipher whitelist: AEAD only (TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256, TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256). Explicitly disable TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA and older.

lena: Also enable strict SNI validation for ingress edge; reject mismatched SNI with 421 and log `sni_mismatch=true`.

omar: For the certificate rotator, add a pre-rotation dry-run that validates OCSP stapling after publishing the new cert and before switching. If stapling fails, keep old cert and page oncall.

kms-ops-bot: note: crypto-key rotation scheduled for ap-south exception group on 2026-04-06T03:00Z.

lena: Ops coordination: support should prepare two canned responses for customers: one for transient 502s explaining controlled fallback and one for long-term key issues.

dakota: Incident playbook quick checklist:
1) Detect: alert fires (unwrap_error_rate or p95 latency)
2) Mitigate: flip feature flag to route 100% through fallback-keystore
3) Revert RBAC if needed (remove rotator binding)
4) Notify: status page + oncall + security
5) Postmortem: include audit logs and unwrap event traces

omar: I'm uploading a CSV of services with current TLS versions and owners to the infra bucket now. Will link here when done.

lena: Great. Next steps: Omar -> owner inventory, Dakota -> audit schema and dashboards, Lena -> IAM PR + rollout plan, Support -> customer comms. We'll reconvene Thu 10am UTC for final go/no-go. @oncall please be available for Sat window. :robot_face:
